name: Stereo
description: Two views the eyes apart, and the offset widening as the subject comes closer.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 12%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: translateX(@calc(-2 - 16 * @y / @Y)%); transform: translateX(@calc(-2 - 16 * @y / @Y)%); opacity: 0.8; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 12%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: translateX(@calc(2 + 16 * @y / @Y)%); transform: translateX(@calc(2 + 16 * @y / @Y)%); opacity: 0.8; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
